spec_features.evidence: All four are enforced in loop.py: solved -> `if result.solved: ... break` (loop.py:117-119) set by `if tc.name == 'run_tests' and out.ok: result.solved = True` (110-111); give_up -> `if result.gave_up: ... break` (120-122) set at 112-114; max_turns -> for/else at 75/127; error budget -> `if errors >= error_budget: ... break` (80-83). Each branch sets terminated_reason and breaks the loop.
